I selected Healing Hands Veterinary Hospital because Dr. Thompson promotes integrative veterinary medicine on the practice’s website. I believed my dogs would receive attentive, whole-patient care. Choosing this practice is now a decision I deeply regret.

My greatest concern was the lack of communication from Dr. Thompson, especially when my dog Dior became seriously ill. During an emergency, I did not receive a return call, an explanation of what might be happening, or clear guidance about the next steps.

On a Friday, Dior was unusually lethargic and clingy. I took her to Healing Hands and spent nearly $900 on specialized bloodwork sent to an outside laboratory. She was sent home without medication to keep her comfortable and without the urgency or follow-up I believe her condition warranted. Later that night, Dior had a seizure, and I rushed her to Mission Vet Emergency Services. Between both facilities, I spent more than $1,600 that day.

Mission Vet shares records with Healing Hands, yet no one from Dior’s primary veterinary practice contacted me afterward to ask how she was doing, discuss the emergency records, or determine whether additional care was needed. That silence was shocking.

The specialized blood tests took approximately three weeks to return. During that time, I had critical decisions to make about Dior’s care. I called Healing Hands almost every other day for an update or to speak with Dr. Thompson. I was repeatedly told that she was out of the office and that the staff could not contact the third-party laboratory to request an update or ask that the results be expedited. Despite my repeated calls and Dior’s urgent condition, Dr. Thompson never contacted me to explain the delay, tell me what we should do while waiting, or discuss the next diagnostic steps.

I am also deeply disturbed by the lack of informed communication surrounding Zenrelia. Dior was prescribed this medication, but its FDA boxed warning was never explained to me. The prescribing information warns of an inadequate immune response to vaccines and directs that Zenrelia be discontinued for at least 28 days to three months before vaccination and withheld for at least 28 days afterward. According to my records, Dior was vaccinated within that timing window, yet I was never counseled about the warning or told that her medication and vaccination schedules needed to be coordinated.

Dior’s condition progressed rapidly. She experienced seizures, neurological decline, severe disorientation and instability, and ultimately died. I cannot medically claim that Healing Hands, Zenrelia, or any single condition caused her death. What I can say is that when Dior became critically ill, I felt abandoned by the veterinarian responsible for her primary care. I was left waiting for answers and trying to make urgent decisions without meaningful guidance from Dr. Thompson.

My three dogs are not simply pets—they are my children and a central part of my life. I trusted Healing Hands to listen, communicate honestly, and respond urgently when one of them was in distress. That trust was broken.

Compassionate veterinary care requires more than ordering expensive tests. It requires explaining medication risks, coordinating treatment and vaccinations, returning calls, following up after emergencies, helping clients understand their options, and showing concern for the animal behind the medical record. That was not my experience.

Because of the lack of communication, failure to explain Zenrelia’s boxed warning, absence of follow-up after Dior’s emergency treatment, and dismissive response to my repeated concerns, I will not entrust my remaining dogs to this practice. I cannot recommend Healing Hands Veterinary Hospital.

I suggest you seek out a different facility for your "FAMILY MEMBER'S" care because this is not it!
After my GSD had an OFA, he needed rehabilitation.  This place was recommended and I was extremely happy with the Dr and the staff. They definitely helped my beautiful dog recover and heal properly.

Dr. Thompson is amazing! She has tons of experience and knowledge. She was super patient with me and answered all my questions. She was great with my pup! We mostly went for PT and acupuncture as my babygirl heals from spinal surgery. My baby worked with Tori for PT and she was also great! My pup was excited every time we entered that PT room! Thank you Dr. Thompson, Bell, Tori, and Mallory for being so kind, patient, compassionate about my baby's rehabilitation. There aren't many  animal rehabilitation facilities here in SA, so initially I was worried, but Dr. Thompson and her staff were great.

10 stars from check-in to check-out and beyond! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This has been our Primary Vet practice for over a year, and I’m so glad I found Healing Hands to take care of my pup!

Dr. Thompson explains everything in human language, never rushes during the consultation, and is always very kind and compassionate when examining or treating my pup. Bell is Olaf’s favorite! She always plays with him and treats him with so much love and kindness. She has been our vet nurse for most of our appointments. :)

We met Dr. Frost this week, and she was also very kind, compassionate, and willing to take good care of my pup. She listened to me and took my point of view into consideration, which I truly appreciated!

From the moment we walk in, we are always greeted with a smile, and they always remember my pup’s name! They are very clear with the information they provide and explain everything in detail, including treatment plans and estimates, so there are no surprises.

They always answer ALL my questions (and believe me… I always have A LOT!). We are always treated with respect and kindness.

I’m very glad I found Healing Hands to take care of Olaf! ❤️🐾

* Services we’ve used include: rehabilitation, laser therapy, annual wellness exams, vaccinations and consultations.

I'm so thankful for Dr. Thompson and her staff. My border collie was experiencing stiffness in her rear leg. Dr. Thompson was able to pinpoint the cause and come up with a plan. The acupuncture and laser therapy treatments have helped her move and feel so much better.
First time visit and feel that my cats needs were assessed accurately and a treatment plan that was affordable and helpful, was agreed upon.
Great service, nice people, and very professional, I have been with them for almost 8 years. . They love my baby (Chapo)
Dr Thompson & her staff have greatly helped out my border collie & his mobility issues. She has also taught me some things I can do at home to help him out.
Pretty great vet

Dr. Thompson and all of the staff were amazing! Bucky's been through a lot in a short amount of time, and it means a lot to me that he go somewhere welcoming. We definitely felt the love. Thank you very much!
Thank you for your support! So glad we can make you and your pets happy :))

The worst vet we have ever seen.

She is always late to her appointment sessions, but if you are late for a bit due to circumstances out of your control, they will cancel your appointment.

Her front office staff is super rude and really incompetent.

She must also be receiving incentives from Zoetis who makes Librela because she keeps pushing it to patients even though she said it can impact cognitive behavior in an animal (making them forget where to relieve themselves etc.).

We went to her for Chinese Medicine, but there are many much better offices which offer that in San Antonio.  Stay away.

Doctor Thompson, her technician’s Sadie and Bell, and all her staff support are hard working, compassionate, and very dedicated. I was nervous initially after reading some reviews, but after a strong recommendation from my vet we went and I’m really glad we did. Doc is very educated and good at explaining exactly what’s going on with your fur baby and the steps needed for recovery. Everyone was sweet and gentle with my boy, I don’t believe he would have recovered as well or as quickly from TPLO without their assistance. I imagine the negative reviews come from folks who are not very good at following directions or keeping their dogs calm.
Thank you for the 5 star review!
We've taken several of our dogs here. It's now our preferred vet. Prices reasonable. Always friendly and professional.

Dr. Thompson is fabulous and I would highly recommend her to those looking for evaluation of potential problem. She identified a disc injury in our pup and after surgery she is doing great! Having underwater tread therapy and acupuncture has sped her recovery along.
Love this place. They take very good care of my fur baby
I love seeing you and Roscoe every week! I’m delighted his treatments have helped his quality of life :)). It’s why we do what we do.
No name? No details? Hard to tell if real or not.

Dr. Thompson is amazing, her office staff is rude and disrespectful to people. Her counter personal yelled at me while I was trying to get a weight on my springer spaniel. I also heard her raise her voice to an elder person because her dog was barking, nothing crazy just barking. I will never use the service again and it’s bad bc my dog did get better. I talked to the office manager but she blew me off bc she was too busy playing with her poodle that wasn’t in a leash.

Where can I even begin to describe how amazing Dr. Thompson is? When I first came to healing hands and met her I was a new transplant from the east coast and my dog broke his pelvis shortly after we moved here. He had surgery etc. but was in a lot of pain post op and wouldn’t walk on his leg. I knew immediately he needed rehab so I stumbled upon healing hands and it’s the best thing that ever happened to Theo (my dog) and I. Not only did she rehab him back to life but her skill set in acupuncture is unmatched. When Theo still was refusing to walk on his leg even in therapy she found a solution to help break his pain cycle- and man did it work! On top of rehab she’s also Theos regular vet, he got sick recently and a very popular ER vet clinic accused me of abusing my dog instead of figuring out what was wrong with him, but Dr. Thompson was quick to act, quick to treat, and Theo made a full recovery. I am so lucky to have her as a vet and that I stumbled upon her doing research on local rehab clinics for animals it’s the best thing that’s happened to us. Moving here was stressful and what Theo went through was traumatic for both of us but now I know that whenever something happens I can trust Dr. Thompson to figure it out. They absolutely do not make vets like her anymore, and anyone else in the area doesn’t hold a candle to her knowledge, ability, skill set, and general care that she has for the animals she treats. We owe her all of our gratitude for all she has done and continues to do with Theo. Do not hesitate to trust her with your fur babies!  Enjoy the sassy picture of the sweet boy she has treated for almost 6 months now :)

I would 100% avoid this clinic. We took our cat in for unusual litter box issues, thinking he had a UTI or blockage. $300 and sent home with a normal diagnosis. But when we asked AI to review the workup, the response was different and more urgent. Three weeks later we're back as the issue has become worse and now our cat is sick. A $900 charge for the 2nd visit with the issues they missed on the first appointment. So far we're $1200 in and all we "think" we know is he has a UTI.

Our pet needed a Rx food and we wanted to buy it online. They charged us $8 simply to get a print out of the prescription. $1200 in and they still want money to give us a Rx.

After talking with the management, it's easy to see they really don't care about the customer nor their satisfaction.

Had my two dogs with them for years. They charge $85 per animal for example appointment. They make appointments for you after seeing your dog for an issue, and when you think that your animal is doing better after a treatment, they charge you a $65 no show fee. I didn’t make the appointment, this is unfair. Even after asking to have that removed from our account, the manager said “no, we have to pay this”. I am not made of money, been there a long time. My dog babies always felt comfortable with the staff. Now they won’t have our business again. It’s sad!
Everyone is very friendly and helpful, thank you for taking care of Frida!!
Poor customer service.

Dropped Tilly in early morning for annual exam, vaccinations & grooming. Vet called my cell & gave me a full update on my pup. She was informative, not rushed, open to questions, kind & very nice. My pup, Tilly deserves this degree of care! I love this veterinary service!

I have four dogs, and Dr. Thompson has seen all of them. She’s incredibly knowledgeable, honest, and truly cares about her patients. My dogs have also done acupuncture and hydrotherapy here, and the results have been wonderful.

I really appreciate how thorough and transparent she is, and I fully trust her with my dogs’ care. Highly recommend.

We’ve been with Dr. Thompson for 2.5 years now. She’s been the biggest blessing to our boys! She’s an AMAZING diagnostician and has saved each of our two big breeds with her knowledge and attentive care. And then when it was finally time for each to go, she showed up in the most compassionate way. Her staff is equally as amazing, especially Belle, who has loved on each of our doggies like they were her own.

It’s our right and responsibility as pet owners to make the best decisions for our animals with the knowledge we have, and there’s no vet I trust more to educate me than Dr. Thompson. If you want a vet to coddle your feelings and give you mediocre care at a fraction of the price, sure go somewhere else. But I’d rather entrust the care of my dogs, who are literal family members, to someone who will tell me exactly what they need and then actually execute the plan of care well.

Looking forward to bringing the newest addition in soon! 🐾

Our corgi Finlay has been getting regular physical therapy after IVDD surgery.  He has mad wonderful progress so far, but the best thing is that he LOVES going to his therapy sessions.  He is so happy to see everyone at the office that he bounces constantly in his stroller until his appointment.
The care is solid, but since they became a franchise of a larger corporation the pricing is out of reach.

Dr Thompson is simply the best. she is the reason my dog has lived such a happy , healthy life.  I cannot say enough about healing hands and our experience there. from regular pet exams to surgery, you wont find a better Vet than Dr Thompson.
Great supportive staff that have helped Jake walk after his back surgery
Thank you for your 5 star review!

We always recommend this vet to all our friends and family.
Dr Thompson is very knowledgeable and her clinic top notch clean .
My wife took out pets and always welcoming and professional.
The prices are great compared to others .
Thank you guys for all your efforts.
❤️

Dr Thompson is the best vet with tons of knowledge and great kindness toward the animals and customers. Her staff is top rated  and their goal is to take great care of the animals. They keep the customer informed about the care and always followup after your pet is back home.
What a fantastic experience.  They traded our 4 legged family member like one of theirs.  Definitely on the road to recovery with this team!

Extremely Disappointed – Unprofessional and Unfair Practices

I had a very frustrating and disappointing experience with Dr. Thompson and the office manager at Healing Hand Vet Hospital. I was shocked to receive a $100 no-show fee, even though this fee was never listed in their written estimate or disclosed in any of their policies provided to me. When I tried to discuss this with the office, I was met with a complete lack of cooperation or professionalism. Instead of working with me to find a fair solution, they were dismissive and unhelpful.

To make matters worse, they attempted to charge me for services that my cat did not need—including microchipping and treatment for a mammary tumor that was never diagnosed or even seen by them. This felt like a clear attempt to upsell unnecessary procedures, which is both unethical and deeply concerning.

It’s extremely disappointing to deal with a veterinary office that seems more interested in collecting unjustified fees than in providing honest, compassionate care. I would strongly caution others to review everything carefully and be aware of hidden fees and questionable charges. I will not be returning to Healing Hand Vet Hospital, and I sincerely hope they reevaluate their approach to client care and transparency.

UPADATE
I strongly disagree with your portrayal of the situation.

There is a clear lack of professionalism in how this was handled. Your records confirm that no mammary tumor was located during the visit, yet it was still included in the estimate. Attempting to justify that as standard procedure is misleading and only reinforces the impression that your clinic prioritizes billing over actual care.

Additionally, there is no written proof or signed acknowledgment that I agreed to a $100 no-show fee. This charge was never disclosed on the estimate or communicated beforehand. Estimating policies based on your assumptions instead of documented agreements is both unethical and unacceptable.

After reviewing not only my experience but also others’ feedback, it’s clear that your clinic places more importance on money than on the pets you claim to care about. I have made the decision not to return to a facility that treats clients this way and disregards accountability.
The staff at Healing Hands is wonderfu and caring.  Going there is a wonderful experience for me and my pup.  Great experience at Healing Hands Veterinary Hospital!

Dr. T is a wealth of knowledge, exhausting all possible options to get her patients “back on their feet”! Erin is a phenomenal therapist, dedicated not only to her canine patients, but also providing empathy and compassion to her human owners as well!

Very unprofessional. Mariah at the front desk has a very poor attitude. They choose to dismiss a patient without the proper form nor did they give me the required/proper time to find another veterinary clinic to care for my pup. After the amount of money and time invested into this facility I find it ridiculous to be dismissed over bad customer service, meanwhile there is no consequence to THEIR employee who cannot speak to customers with dignity and respect. When calling to confirm perhaps get your ducks in a row to relay all information required. Had I known certain information 4 hours prior I would have been able to make accommodations. Instead of an apology I received “well that’s why I’m calling you now and I’m telling you now”. Not sure what integrity this medical office has if they cannot even provide basic customer care. Unfortunately this has NOT been the first time I’ve experienced bad service. It’s a shame that my dog will be the one who suffers due to poor communication!

Mariah has given me the worst attitude over my pets appointments. Policy is to give proper notice for cancelation, I had a medical emergency and still got charged. They argued with me over the fact that it’s their policy and they have to abide certain rules. So if you’re in a life or death situation make sure you call and cancel your pets appointment.
Not sending me with specific meds then threatening to cancel my appt because of it (not even 24 hours advance AFTER I had been called to confirm and on my birthday) is ridiculous. The way this business is ran is poor. There has been some positive change for my boy but dealing with rude and inconsiderate people really makes it difficult to WANT to go back.
I have two pets tht have been going here since they were pups. They are now 14 and 8. The doctors are great, and the front staff is just as great.
Great service & care for many years!

My senior dog, Sonny, and very senior cat, Halle Berry, have been receiving excellent heath care at Healing Hands since I first heard about Healing Hands in late December 2022.

The vets, vet techs and front office staff are always kind, thoughtful, through and communicate well with me about my pets health issues.
Terribly high prices. Staff is rude, the office manager is the worst of them all.
Terrible vet. They over charge for everything and very rude.

My family and I have trusted Dr. Thompson with our dogs from puppyhood to crossing the rainbow bridge. She genuinely cares and takes a proactive approach, especially with my dog’s severe allergies and ear infections, exploring various treatments. Ms. Thea is an amazing groomer who once noticed my dog shaking his ears and arranged a quick vet check during his bath just in case. The team is also incredibly thoughtful, ensuring my reactive dog, is quickly moved to a room to avoid triggers. I’ve never had a bad visit and am grateful to the Healing Hands team!

I’m very sad to say that this place is not what I thought it was going to be. I actually made my husband take our dogs here because I thought that their reviews were good. It has been nothing but a nightmare to try to get our Luna fixed. First, they said she had some kind of blood disorder or something to that nature. Which we spent a lot of money fixing. Which postponed her being able to be fixed until that was taken care of which we understood. Then we were told that She was finally able to get fixed so we made the appointment. They knew exactly how much she weighed and still set the appointment!!!. When my husband called to check on surgery and ask some additional questions,,(this is the day before the surgery) we were informed that they were no longer going to perform the surgery on her because our Luna now weighed more than 60 pounds (which we informed them how much she weighted) and they just canceled the appointment without letting us know!!! She’s actually at 57 pounds but the point is that they have charged us enormous amounts of money to have her “fixed”in order to be able to get her surgery and nothing is going to be done now. We have gone back to our original vet. The only reason we left him is because he’s a little bit further away. What a big mistake. This whole thing has been and I would highly just avoid this establishment. Something shady going on there. Disconnect with Dr and team.
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating – it's much appreciated!

Please update your hours. Google says Healing Hands opens at 8 AM on Saturday. It’s a Saturday and I’m here at 9:30 (writing this review while sitting in my car) because it says you open at 8 on Saturdays.

Very professional and informative. I would recommend a consultation to see if this treatment plan could be of help to your pet. I will be making a followup appointment on the treatment plan for Maggie Mae.

Worst call in experience anywhere ever. Called asking questions about cancer treatment and when i started asking more specific questions mariah didnt know how to answer she just hung up on me, after calling back 5 times and getting hung up on i was put on hold and then had to call back 20 more times just to get them to stop auto hanging up. I asked why she hung up on me and if thats how you deal with customers asking questions because thats very rude and she said sorry and hung up again. After getting hung up on 30 more times  automatically the same person answered and made threats of calling the police for harassment. Kept calling until she finally chose to stop hanging up and prentended to be someone else and finally told me the dr said they couldn't do what i asked after stating the cops were on the way. Mariah definitely shouldn't be handling a phone at any business anywhere.  Also looks like the horrible customer service runs downhill from the top according to other yelp reviews.
I had a great experience and appreciated all the time Dr Thompson spent with us.

I love Dr Thompson.
I trust my babies with them as Dr Thompson is the biggest animal lover I have met. They only uphold the highest standard of care. A bit cheaper than the other clinics in the area is a plus too.

If you are worried that your dog is going to get autism or something from a vaccination, please get off of fox news and start making adult decisions. If you don't believe in medical professionals, this isn't the hospital for you.
Loki was groomed, he loves Theadora and always looks great!

Meant to leave a review quite a while ago and I forgot until a friend of mine just had a bad experience at helping hands…so here we go. My biggest complaint at this office is that the vet assistant, as well as vet, were VERY VERY vaccine pushy. VERY VERY any type of flea and tick and heart worm medication pushy. Not everyone is on the same page with this topic and I respect that, but we are a family who does not over vaccinate nor over medicate. They would not even see my dogs until they had their vaccine’s. In my opinion, a health issue takes precedence over whether or not your dog is “up to date”. Not only did I like how pushy and rude they were, they are outrageously priced! I found an AMAZING vet closer to me in Boerne who actually cares more about my dogs well-being over their vaccination status and their visits are much less than Helping Hands! Hope this helps someone new who may be looking for a friendlier vet who cares more about the pet over vaccine status!!!

I usually go there 4 times a year
But last time we came late because of traffic and the front office attendant gave us hard time .
Also my girlfriend tried to ask about next door if this available for rent and receptionist told us there is a number we can call . My girlfriend told her the number we called not answering and if you know any details about rent she rudely said the might call back .
Never spending my money after this unprofessional unpleasant experience

Hello,

If you are an active client with a concern, we would love to speak to you in regards to what happened to see if we can assist with making your experience better.  

Thank you,
Management

Having undertaken the care of a handicapped Great Dane we needed to find a somewhat close veterinarian who could provide general veterinary care.  Healing Hands kept coming up on our "radar" searches.  We have visited twice - once with and once without the dog and are very pleased with the facility, the doctor and the staff
